admin.lightDone: Done. Open the page again to see the updated lists.
admin.checkInRefused: Only confirmed registrations can be checked in.
admin.cancelled: Registration cancelled. Freed places go to the waiting list.
admin.moved: Moved to the end of the waiting list. The next person in line is offered the free places within a minute.
admin.moveRefused: Only people who are waiting can be moved (not while they have an offer).
admin.moveRace: The waiting list changed at the same moment. Please try again.
admin.maintenance: Expired {expired} offer(s), sent {promoted} new offer(s){more, select, true {; more work remains for the next minute} other {}}.
admin.ledgerStatus.BUSY: had activity in the last 10 minutes; it will be checked later.
admin.ledgerStatus.TOO_LARGE: has too many records to check in one pass.
admin.ledgerStatus.CONFLICT: changed while being checked; it will be retried.
admin.noSiteUrlBody: Set the site URL so download links can be generated.
admin.linkNote: The link works once, for 10 minutes. Open the .html file and print it.
admin.rosterIntro: Tick people off as they arrive. This page also works on a phone.
admin.declineText: Their places are released and they get an email.
admin.approvedSent: Approved. The confirmation email is sent.
admin.approvedQueued: Approved. The confirmation email goes out within a minute.
admin.declinedToast: Declined. The places are free again.
admin.moveTitle: Move {name} to the end of the waiting list?
admin.moveText: They keep a place in line, behind everyone else, and get an email. Use this when the free places are too few for their booking and others are waiting.
admin.cancelText: Their places go to the waiting list. This cannot be undone.
admin.heatmapHeader: Which days and times fill up fastest
admin.heatmapIntro: Average share of places in use by weekday and start hour, for upcoming dates with a limit. Busiest first.
admin.noAttendeesSelection: Nobody registered for this selection yet.
admin.noRsvps: Nobody has registered yet. Registrations appear here as they come in.
admin.settingsIntro: Technical settings, normally set once when the site is built. Email links open the self-service page on your site, which must show the RsvpManage component.
admin.componentsHint: Site components (RsvpForm, RsvpManage): use apiEndpoint "/_emdash/api/plugins/{id}/rsvp" and apiBase "/_emdash/api/plugins/{id}".
admin.fieldReminders: Send a reminder this many hours before the event (0 = no reminder)
admin.fieldRetentionDays: Delete names, emails and answers this many days after the event (30–3650)
admin.fieldDefaultTimezone: Time zone for events that don't have their own, for example Europe/Zurich (empty: UTC)
admin.fieldLocale: Language of emails when the form doesn't say
admin.fieldTurnstileSiteKey: Cloudflare Turnstile site key (optional; empty = off)
admin.turnstileSecretSaved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
admin.turnstileOn: Turnstile is on: the booking form shows Cloudflare's check, and bookings without a valid token are refused. If Cloudflare can't be reached, bookings go through.
admin.turnstileOff: Turnstile is off. To turn it on, create a widget for this site's domain in the Cloudflare dashboard (Turnstile) and paste both keys above.
admin.tasksIntro: Waiting-list offers move on every minute, and counts are checked every 10 minutes. You can run either now.
admin.runMaintenance: Move the waiting list on now
admin.personalDataIntro: When someone asks you to delete their details (GDPR, FADP), look them up by email address.
admin.eraseConfirmText: Names, email addresses and answers are removed for good. Seat counts stay. Live registrations are not erased: cancel them first.
admin.noPersonalDataFound: No records found for this email address.
admin.erasedMore: Erased {n}. Press again for the rest.
admin.erasedAll: Personal data erased ({n, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}).
admin.noUpcoming: No upcoming events with registrations yet.
admin.openEvent: Open an event in the content editor to set up its registrations.
admin.notConfigured: Attendance applies to: {collections}. Add this collection on the Attendance admin page if bookings should be taken for it.
admin.saveFirst: Save the event first, then set up its registrations here.
admin.panelNotSaved: Nothing was saved: fix the questions first.
admin.ticketedBody: Free registration is off for this event. Set it up in the Tickets panel instead.
admin.enableHelp: Visitors can register on your site. Turn this off to stop new registrations; existing ones stay.
admin.maxPerBooking: Most places one person can book
admin.allowWaitlistHelp: When all places are taken, visitors can join a waiting list. Freed places are offered in order of arrival.
admin.requireApprovalHelp: Registrations wait, holding their places, until you approve or decline them on the Registrations page.
admin.eventReplyTo: Replies to this event's emails go to (optional)
admin.placesTaken: {n, plural, one {# place} other {# places}} taken
admin.placesTakenAllDates: {n, plural, one {# place} other {# places}} taken across all dates
admin.fromEventHint: Change this in the event's own capacity and waiting-list fields.
admin.fromEventOverridden: These values were saved here earlier and replace the event's own fields. Save below to follow the event's capacity and waiting-list fields from now on.
admin.savedSeparately: Use this button to save these settings; the event's own Save doesn't include them. They apply to every language version of the event.
admin.qIntro: Name and email are always asked. Add your own questions, such as T-shirt size or dietary needs. Each question is saved on its own; answers appear in the registration list, the door list and the CSV.
admin.qRemoveText: The question disappears from the form. Answers already given stay with their registrations.
admin.qGone: This question no longer exists. Reload the page.
admin.siteSetupHeader: Site setup (for whoever built the site)
admin.attentionText: These people asked to register. Their places are held until you approve or decline; if you don't answer in time, the request lapses.
admin.attentionMore: And {n} more: they are in the list below with the status "Awaiting approval".
admin.filterSearch: Find a name or email address (optional)
admin.searchNone: Nobody found with that name or email address.
admin.searchPartial: The list is long and was not searched to the end: choose an event to narrow it down.
admin.phoneHint: On a phone the buttons in this table are hidden: search for a name above, or use the door list.
admin.doorChooseText: Pick the event you are checking people in for, then press Show.
admin.doorCount: {n} of {of}{more, select, true {+} other {}} checked in
admin.doorPrintIntro: Prefer paper or a spreadsheet? Make a file of this list.
admin.truncated: Showing the first {n} attendees; filter by event to export the rest.
admin.questionIssues.NO_LABEL: {hasLine, select, true {Line {line}: } other {}}write the question first.
admin.questionIssues.LABEL_TOO_LONG: {hasLine, select, true {Line {line}: } other {}}the question is longer than {limit} characters.
admin.questionIssues.BAD_TYPE: {hasLine, select, true {Line {line}: } other {}}"{value}" isn't a type. Use one of: text, textarea, email, phone, number, date, checkbox, select.
admin.questionIssues.BAD_REQUIRED: {hasLine, select, true {Line {line}: } other {}}write "required" or "optional" in the third column.
admin.questionIssues.NO_OPTIONS: {hasLine, select, true {Line {line}: } other {}}a choice from a list needs at least one choice, for example S, M, L.
admin.questionIssues.OPTION_TOO_LONG: {hasLine, select, true {Line {line}: } other {}}a choice can be at most {limit} characters.
admin.questionIssues.OPTIONS_NOT_ALLOWED: {hasLine, select, true {Line {line}: } other {}}only select questions take options.
email.rsvpConfirmed.subject: RSVP confirmed: {title}
email.requestReceived.subject: Request received: {title}
email.requestReceived.text:
Hi {name},

We received your request for {title}. The organiser will confirm or decline it by {deadline}; your seat is held until then.

To withdraw your request:
{cancelUrl}
email.requestDeclined.subject: Request declined: {title}
email.requestDeclined.text:
Hi {name},

The organiser declined your request for {title}. Your seat has been released.
email.requestLapsed.subject: Request lapsed: {title}
email.requestLapsed.text:
Hi {name},

Your request for {title} wasn't answered in time, so it has lapsed and your seat was released.
email.organiserNewRequest.subject: New request: {name} for {title}
email.organiserNewRequest.text: {name} ({email}) asked for {quantity, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}} for {title} on {date}. Approve or decline it on the Attendance page before {deadline}.
email.waitlisted.subject: Waitlist confirmation: {title}
email.waitlisted.text:
Hi {name},

You are on the waitlist for {title} (position #{position}).

If a spot becomes available you will receive an email with a 2-hour window to claim it.

To leave the waitlist:
{cancelUrl}
email.offer.subject: A spot has opened up for {title}! Claim within 2 hours
email.offer.text:
Hi {name},

A spot has opened up for you for {title}!

Please claim your reservation within 2 hours using this link:
{claimUrl}

If you do not claim within 2 hours, the spot will be offered to the next person in line.
email.claimConfirmed.subject: Spot confirmed: {title}
email.movedToEnd.subject: Waitlist update: {title}
email.movedToEnd.text:
Hi {name},

You are still on the waitlist for {title}, now at the end of the line. The organiser moved you because the next free seats could not fit your booking of {quantity, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}} and others were waiting.

If enough seats become available you will get an email with a 2-hour window to claim them. To leave the waitlist instead, use the link in your original confirmation email.
email.reminder.subject: Reminder: {title}, {when}
